column1: # clues.tsv for ft_putchar (rush) — hints only, never answers.
# (This test is unlabeled, so this single hint fires on any failure.)

ft_putchar receives one character and must put it on the screen with the only function this project allows. Read that function's manual page (man 2 write) until you can say, in your own words, everything it needs to be told about the bytes you are handing it — then check that your call tells it all of that.
